name: XO, Kitty
description: Teen matchmaker Kitty Song Covey thinks she knows everything there is to know about love. But when she moves halfway across the world to reunite with her long-distance boyfriend, she'll soon realise that relationships are a lot more complicated when it's your heart on the line.

videos.title: XO
videos.overview: Yearning to feel closer to her late mother and surprise her long-distance boyfriend, Kitty sets her sights on attending a prestigious school in Seoul.

videos.title: WTF
videos.overview: A jet-lagged Kitty can't wait to see Dae, but their long-awaited reunion goes awry due to dormitory complications and the fallout from a viral video.

videos.title: KISS
videos.overview: Dae experiences conflicting emotions over a sudden change of plans as Kitty deals with her own tangled feelings and an unfortunate new nickname.

videos.title: TGIF
videos.overview: Kitty joins Q's outdoor club to connect with Dae away from school, but a clue about her mom soon sends her on a fact-finding — and matchmaking — mission.

videos.title: TBH
videos.overview: With no plans for the Chuseok holiday, Kitty attempts to prepare a special feast for other students on campus with help from an unlikely source.

videos.title: BYOB
videos.overview: Drama erupts and romantic connections emerge at Min Ho's swanky party, where a determined Kitty intends to work through her feelings about Dae.

videos.title: TIL
videos.overview: Tensions turn into revelations during a Saturday detention session after Kitty reluctantly agrees to help Yuri figure out what Principal Jina is hiding.

videos.title: LFG
videos.overview: A school trip gives Dae a chance to regain Kitty's trust as Yuri opens up about Juliana, Florian confides in Q, and Min Ho makes a relationship decision.

videos.title: SNAFU
videos.overview: With finals approaching, Kitty leans on her friends for extra help, but tempers flare at KISS and beyond amid bombshells, betrayals and blazing fights.

videos.title: OTP
videos.overview: Final grades, class rankings and complicated truths cause emotions to run high as Kitty takes a stand with her future at KISS hanging in the balance.

videos.title: K.I.S.S. Me Again
videos.overview: Determined to avoid romantic chaos and learn more about her mom, Kitty returns to Seoul. But with new roommates and unresolved crushes, it's complicated.

videos.title: Never Been Kissed
videos.overview: Kitty pursues a new love interest, but a night of dancing spins into drama. A fierce competition emerges during class, and Q's track rival plays dirty.

videos.title: New Year's Kiss
videos.overview: During Seollal, Kitty and Praveena enlist Min Ho's help for a heist, Juliana confronts Yuri, and sparks fly from a bonding moment years in the making.

videos.title: Kiss and Tell
videos.overview: A wintry weekend at Min Ho's ski cabin turns into a WiFi-less nightmare when Kitty and the gang get snowed in — and shocking revelations come to light.

videos.title: Kissing Cousins
videos.overview: As suspicions about Stella grow, Kitty chases a lead to long-lost relatives as Yuri tries to make amends with Juliana. Another scandal rocks the school.

videos.title: Kiss and Make Up
videos.overview: As Min Ho and Yuri do damage control to fix fractured relationships, a friendly face from home pays Kitty a visit — and brings life-changing information.

videos.title: Kiss of Death
videos.overview: On the eve of the Cherry Blossom Ball, Kitty focuses on family while following a hunch about Stella. Yuri helps Dae prepare for his performance.

videos.title: Sealed with a Kiss
videos.overview:
Season Finale: Dreams hang in the balance as Stella's concert plan comes together. With emotions running high, will Kitty reveal her feelings before the semester ends?

Season Finale

videos.title: Guest List
videos.overview: With just hours to go before summer break, Kitty resolves to share her feelings with Min Ho, but a crowded trip to Busan threatens to kill the vibe.

videos.title: Sunset List
videos.overview: Kitty returns to Seoul with a game plan for an unforgettable semester, only to discover a cocky ex-classmate is back — and out to upstage her.

videos.title: Play List
videos.overview: As Min Ho works to pull off Eunice's video shoot, a stylish newcomer sets off Kitty's insecurities. Yuri hustles to make the most of a new opportunity.

videos.title: A List
videos.overview: Awaiting the results of their midterm exams, the group lets loose at an amusement park, where a daunting ride rattles Kitty's confidence.

videos.title: Off the List
videos.overview: Kitty tries to shake her suspicions as family and friends convene for a Chuseok feast, but drama erupts when explosive secrets spill into the open.

videos.title: Wait List
videos.overview: A visitor from home tries to lift Kitty's spirits. Eunice makes a career decision with consequences for Min Ho. Q and Marius retread the past.

videos.title: Best Dressed List
videos.overview: Kitty scrambles to mend friendships ahead of Yuri's fashion show — and she's not the only matchmaker trying to stitch the group back together.

videos.title: Wish List
videos.overview: The KISS crew navigates old flames, new prospects and second chances as they gather to celebrate Kitty's 18th birthday.
